name: Feature request
about: Explain how a feature would benefit the creator as a Japanese learner.

Hachidori is [opinionated](https://github.com/bee-san/hachidori/blob/main/README.md#optionated). Its creator mainly reads visual novels and manga, and will only add features that benefit them personally as a Japanese learner. Features that add bloat without that benefit will be declined.

Complete every section and check the acknowledgement. Incomplete issues are closed automatically.
